verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is API-first: its payments, payouts, mandates, verification and data products are documented as APIs, with SDKs and an MCP server on top. However, several functions are documented only in the Console UI, with no API equivalent shown: payment monitoring and reports, merchant balance reports and sweeping configuration, user invites, and webhook URI setup. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for Console functions (reporting, sweeping config, team/user management, webhook URI configuration), an explicit API–UI parity statement, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
